summary: Permit audited atomic upgrade from a drifted managed target

delivery.outcome: Atomic standard upgrades accept a previously drifted managed file only when the ticket binds its exact base digest and the target payload still matches the immutable new lock.
nonGoals: Do not allow an unbound managed-file drift
Do not weaken lock, tag, release or target payload verification
Do not treat ordinary target-owned files as managed

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing managedTargetTakeovers binding as a one-time digest-bound acknowledgement for either a new managed target or a drifted formerly managed target.
architecture.rollback: Revert the verifier change; the prior stricter refusal resumes.

validation.evidence: A positive fixture requires the exact base digest for a drifted old managed file.
Missing and incorrect takeover bindings remain deterministic failures.
